test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate degree of comparison to fill in the blank.

Work in this office is done in the ________ way.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. least efficient .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **comparing **the **efficiency **of work done in the office.
 
• When making **comparisons**, especially with **adjectives**, we use the **comparative degree** (e.g., less efficient) or the **superlative degree** (e.g., least efficient).
 
• Since the sentence is indicating the **lowest degree of efficiency**, the correct form to use is the **superlative degree (least)**.
 
• Among the given options, **"least efficient"** is the superlative form and correctly completes the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Work in this office is done in the **least efficient** way*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Degree:**

 
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare two entities.
 
• **Example:** This method is less efficient than the other one.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Degree:**
 
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare more than two entities and indicate the highest or lowest degree.
 
• **Example: **This is the least efficient method of all.
